ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that points $A$, $B$, $C$, and $D$ lie on the same straight line, point $C$ is the midpoint of segment $AB$, and point $D$ is on segment $AB$. If $AB=6$ and $BD=\frac{1}{3}BC$, what is the length of segment $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since point C is the midpoint of segment AB, and $AB=6$, \\
therefore $BC= \frac{1}{2}AB=3$, \\
since $BD=\frac{1}{3}BC$, \\
thus $BD=\frac{1}{3} \times 3=1$, \\
therefore $CD=BC-BD=3-1=\boxed{2}$.
